why: Allows players to plan actions ahead and visualize the queuedActions that drive deterministic battle execution.
Enforces invariants and sanitizes battle state coming from saves or external inputs to prevent UI/runtime errors.
Provides seeded PRNG streams and replay hooks so battles are reproducible for testing and debugging.
Centralizes damage, mana, and reward formulas to avoid duplicated magic numbers and enable balanced tuning.
Presents XP, level-ups, djinn/equipment changes and applies progression logic after victory.
Handles serialization, validation, and autosave policies to maintain campaign continuity and safe restores.
Applies level and equipment normalization for gauntlet/tower runs so rules are consistent across floors.
Restores focus when menus close and uses reference-counted input locks to prevent input leakage during modal overlays.
Wires encounter triggers through pre-battle and into the planning UI, ensuring a cohesive player flow between exploration and combat.
Gates heavy visual tests and provides deterministic hooks (replay, RNG) so CI remains stable while exercising critical flows.
